verses.text: Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés t'a Jehová: --Manh ol yak'ochlaj heb' t'a sk'ool, manh ol sk'anab'ajejlaj heb' tas ol wala', axom ol yutej heb' yalan t'ayin: Mato wal yel ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová chi' t'ayach mato maay, scham heb' t'ayin, xchi winh.
--¿Tas jun et'nak chi'? xchi Jehová t'a winh. --Ha te' in k'okoch, xchi winh.
--Aktejem te' t'a sat lum chi', xchi Jehová chi'. Ix yaktanem te' sk'okoch winh chi' t'a sat lu'um, elanhchamel ix och te' chanil. Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Moisés chi', ix el lemnaj winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh: --Yam snhe nok' chan chi', xchi. Ix syaman snhe nok' chi' winh, ix ochxi sk'okochok winh.

--Yuj tas toxo ix il tik, ol yak'och heb' t'a sk'ol to ix in ch'ox in b'a t'ayach, a in ton Jehová a Diosal in, sDiosal in pax heb' he mam eyicham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob, xchi.

Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ha tiknaik, ak'em a k'ab' t'a snhi' a k'ool, xchi. Ix yak'anem sk'ab' winh chi' t'a snhi' sk'ool, haxo ix yik'anelta sk'ab' winh chi', ayxo och yab'il lepra t'ay, toxonhej sakwekinak yilji icha k'een cheew.

Ix yalanxi Jehová chi': --Ak'xiem a k'ab' chi' t'a snhi' a k'ool, xchi. Ix yak'anxiem sk'ab' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a snhi' sk'ol chi', haxo ix yik'anxik'eta sk'ab' winh chi', te wach'xo icha wal sniwanil winh smasanil.
Ix yalan Jehová: --Tato max yak'och heb' anima chi' t'a sk'ol tas tzala', tato max sk'anab'ajej pax heb' yuj jun b'ab'el ch'oxnab'il tik, yuj jun schab'il ol yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool.

Palta tato max yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool, max schaanpax heb' yab' yuj chab' ch'oxnab'il tik, tzik'k'eta jab'ok ha ha' t'a ha' niwan Nilo, tza sekanem ha' t'a sat lu'um, tzanhej wal em ha' t'a sat lum chi', tz'och ha' chik'al, xchi Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a Jehová icha tik: --Ay, ach Mamin Wajalil. Komonok manhok in tzin a chekb'ati, yujto yelxo wal max yal-laj in loloni, manhokto tzalan t'ayin tik swalani, palta toxonton in k'olb'al, tewelnhej syal in loloni, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Jehová chi': --¿Mach yuj syal slolon heb' anima tza na'a? ¿Tom manh wujok slolon heb'? Anhejtona' in swak' chakanhb'ok heb' yet' heb' max yal sloloni yet' heb' max yal yilani. Ha in swak' yil heb' wach' yilani.
Yuj chi, ixik, ol in ochnhej et'ok ayik ol ach lolonok. Anheja' in ol wal tas ol ala', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan winh: --Ay Mamin Wajalil, komonok manhok in tzin a chekb'ati. Wach' tza say junokxo mach, xchi winh.

Ix kot yowal Jehová t'a winh ix yalani: --Ha t'a Egipto chi', ata' ayek' winh uk'tak aj Aarón, yinhtilal winhaj Leví. Wojtak to b'ekan sk'ool winh sloloni. Ol kot winh ach scha'a. Ol te tzalaj winh ayik ol ach yilani.
Ha ach ol ach lolon t'a winh. Ol alani tas ol yutok winh sloloni. Ha inxo ol wal t'ayex ayik wan he lolon chi', ol wak'an he nael masanil tas ol he k'ulej.
Ha ach tzach lolon t'a winhaj Aarón chi' in k'exulok, haxo winh ol lolon t'a heb' chonhab' a k'exulok.
Ik'b'at te' a k'okoch chi', yujto a te' ol ak'lab'ej ayik ol a ch'oxan juntzanh ch'oxnab'il ix wal t'ayach.

Ix meltzaj winhaj Moisés t'a spat winh snhi', haton winhaj Jetro, ix yalan winh: --Ol in meltzaj t'a Egipto yik sb'at wilan heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok, yik swila' tato pitzanto heb', xchi winh. --Ixik, tzil wal a b'a t'a yoltak b'e, xchi winhaj Jetro chi'.
Ayik aytoek' winhaj Moisés t'a yol yik Madián chi', ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh: --Ixik t'a Egipto, manh ach xiw a b'ati, yujto chamnakxo heb' snib'ej ach smilanchamok, xchi.

Ix yik'anb'at ix yetb'eyum winhaj Moisés yet' heb' yuninal, ix yak'ank'e heb' winh t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru, ix b'at heb' t'a Egipto chi'. Yet'nak te' sk'okoch winh, haton te' ix yal Dios to ol och yopisio yuj winh.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: --Ayik ol ach k'och t'a Egipto chi', naannhej uuj to ol a ch'ox juntzanh ch'oxnab'il te satub'tak t'a yichanh winh rey, haton juntzanh ix wak' a k'ulej. Palta a in ol wak' pitb'okel spensar winh, yuj chi' manh ol ex schael-laj winh.
Slajwi chi', ol alan t'a winh: Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ha jun chonhab' Israel tik, icha wal to sb'ab'el wuninal yaji.
Toxo ix wal t'ayach to tza chab'at heb' wuninal tik yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ayin. Palta toxonton malaj a gana tzaktejeli, yuj chi' ol in milcham winh a b'ab'el unin, xchi Jehová, xa chi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Moisés t'a Egipto chi'. Ha t'a yoltak b'e b'aj t'inhan sway winh yet' heb' ajun yet'ok, ata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winh, ijan ix miljicham winh yuj.

Elanhchamel ix yik'kot jun kuchilub' ix Séfora, nab'a komon k'een, ix spolanel stz'umal sjolom swinakil winh yune' ix, ix sjulanoch ix t'a yok winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan ix: Yujto wetb'eyum ach, yuj chi' lokan in t'a jun chik' tz'el tik, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi' majxo miljichamlaj winh yuj Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Aarón: --Ixik b'at a cha winh uk'tak aj Moisés t'a tzinan lu'um, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix kot winhaj Aarón scha winhaj Moisés chi' t'a jun witz b'aj ix sch'ox sb'a Dios. Axo yik ix schalan sb'a heb' winh, ix yak'lan stzatzil sk'ol heb' winh, ix stz'ub'lanelta sti' heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winhaj Moisés yalan t'a winhaj Aarón chi' masanil tas ix schek Jehová yala' yet' juntzanh ch'oxnab'il ix chekchaj sch'ox winh.
Ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil, ix smolb'an heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel heb' winh t'a Egipto chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winhaj Aarón yalan t'a heb' smasanil tas ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix sch'oxanpax juntzanh ch'oxnab'il winh yil heb' chonhab' chi'.
Yuj chi', ix yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool tas ix yal heb' winh. Ayik ix yab'an heb' to ix iljikot heb' yuj Jehová, yujto te ilb'ajk'ol tz'utaj heb', yuj chi' ix em nhojan heb' ejmelal t'a yichanh Jehová.
